doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash().

lmb.source: the hammer is busy with the spin: the throw or the swing starts when the dash ends

rmb.source: Brightshield can be raised at once

e.source: Regen Field can be cast at once

lmb.source: as the ground dash: the throw or the swing starts when the shove ends
the charged swing ends on a dash
